---
title: "Stage 6 – Reading the curve you joined"
---
This stage asks what the curve you joined establishes, now that your own dot is on it. Both pages are short, and both are more useful after Task 5 than before it.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) | Where the idea came from, the three purposes that a multiverse can serve and why they pull apart, and the critical positions of 2025–26 read against the course grid. | 60 minutes |
| [The multiverse: 'There is only one correct analysis'](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-lakens) | Section 4 deserves its own sitting. Grant the argument for a moment and ask what would follow for the specification you just declared. | 30 minutes |
| [Reading a specification curve](../../exercise/reading-inference.qmd) | Why 840 estimates are not 840 independent tests, what a permutation design would supply, and what stands without one. | 45 minutes |

**By the end of the stage** you can say what the curve you joined establishes about the claim, what it does not, and what would have to be run for it to establish more.
